rounds.title: Accordion baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK accordion (et-accordion in an et-accordion-group), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page: four items (one expandable to body text, one with a hint, a plain one, a disabled one with a hint), collapsed, expanded, the disabled header under a forced hover, and header hover, active and focus-visible. The accordion has no variants, sizes or colour inputs; the chevron is the only indicator. Fixed numbers: header label and body text 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark; hint and chevron in the muted surface text 7.81:1 light, 6.94:1 dark (on hover both turn to the full text colour, 16.44:1 light and 15.61:1 dark against the hover fill); the disabled header label is the same muted colour, 7.81:1 light and 6.94:1 dark, and its chevron and hint do not change, so a disabled header differs from an enabled one only by the label colour, which equals an enabled hint. A forced hover on the disabled header draws nothing (as expected). Edges and fills, numbers only (Q98 pane edges and Q101 hover fill steps are open): the item divider is 1.26:1 against the page light, 1.73:1 dark, and the divider under a hovered header darkens to 1.88:1 light, 2.94:1 dark; the hover fill is 1.09:1 against the page light, 1.10:1 dark; the active fill 1.19:1 light, 1.25:1 dark (1.09:1 and 1.14:1 against the hover fill). Today on light the focus outline fails: it is the 2px primary mint, 1.33:1 against the page (dark 13.50:1). Not this round's question: the divider and hover/active fill (Q98, Q101); how a disabled header is set apart; the hint and chevron colour. Variant b applies only decided rule Q88 (focus outline in --et-theme-color-ink-solid); Q99 rule a has no other target here (no mint edge, dot, text or fill in the accordion), and the round adds no edge, so Q102 does not arise. Variant a shows today.

a.note: Today: the header focus outline is the 2px primary mint, 1.33:1 against the light page (dark 13.50:1), under the 3:1 of WCAG 1.4.11 in light. Text, chevron, divider and fills as in the round note.

b.note: Pick. Decided rule Q88, not a new call: the header focus outline in --et-theme-color-ink-solid, 5.48:1 against the light page; in dark the ink is the mint, so dark is unchanged at 13.50:1. Nothing else changes; no edge is added, so Q102 does not apply. Divider and fills as in a (Q98, Q101 open).
